# Third-party skills

Vendored into `skills/` for company install via `npx skills`. Pin SHAs in [SOURCES.txt](./SOURCES.txt).

| Upstream | License | What we took |
|---|---|---|
| [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) | MIT — [mattpocock-skills.MIT](./mattpocock-skills.MIT) | Upstream `engineering/*` + `productivity/*` → same buckets here (not `misc/`, `in-progress/`, `deprecated/`) |
| [thananon/9arm-skills](https://github.com/thananon/9arm-skills) | No LICENSE in repo at pin time | Upstream `engineering/*` + `productivity/*` → same buckets here (not `personal/`, `in-progress/`, `deprecated/`) |
| [JuliusBrussee/caveman](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman) | MIT — [caveman.MIT](./caveman.MIT) | `skills/caveman` → `skills/productivity/caveman` |

Company-authored: `skills/company/wiki-publish`.
